}}'''Charral''' is a ''[[damane]]'' hailing from [[Seanchan]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Charral}}

==Appearance==
She has gray hair and gray eyes. So she is very old.

Charral is the most agile of the six Tuon's ''damane'' in her weaving. However, she is weaker in the One Power than [[Sera]]

==Activities==
She is one of [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag]]'s personal ''damane'' who is aboard the ''[[Victory of Kidron]]'' and part of the [[Corenne]]. Tuon describes her spinning as very agile.
